siblings.title: Staffing and rota
turns: How many nurses do we need on the late shift?
Four nurses on the late shift. That is the number that held the average wait under the target on the two weeks we measured.
Weekends run on three, because arrivals drop by roughly a third.

siblings.title: Waiting time review
turns: Where did the average wait end up?
The average wait came down to 24 minutes after the triage change, from 39 minutes before it.
It held for six consecutive weeks, so yes, it looks sustained rather than a blip.
